## Principles

- Idempotent by default
- Everything in Git
- Test before deployment
- Maintain runbooks

## Projects

- Zero-touch fleet patching
- Puppet to Ansible migration
- Self-service VM provisioning

## Services

- Ansible Automation Platform design and support
- Linux infrastructure consulting
- Automation migration services
- Virtualization & private cloud solutions
- Automation coaching
